records.text: If Candace Owens interviewed Mitch Snow, Brian Harpole was going to sue her.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 69A8TzAGHlU)

appearances.snippet: Brian Harpole where he's going to sue you. That's what came down the pipeline to me. So before I even got to do the interview, Brian Harpole was telling people to say that if I interview this guy, I'm going to sue you.

verification.notes: Harpole later filed a lawsuit, but the alleged pre-interview warning was relayed privately through unnamed intermediaries. No source independently verifies that Harpole made this conditional threat before the Mitch Snow interview.

conveyance.original_source: Message relayed through Paramount Tactical and a Valhalla contact
